network.unreachable: The engine is not responding. It may still be starting.

sidecar.spawn_failed: The engine could not be started. The installation may be incomplete.
sidecar.startup_timeout: The engine did not finish starting in time.
sidecar.not_ready: The engine is still starting. Try again in a moment.

storage.invalid_path: That folder cannot be used for the application's data.
storage.path_not_absolute: Choose a full path, starting from a drive or from the root.
storage.path_too_long: That path is too long to be a folder.
storage.path_invalid: That path contains characters a folder name cannot have.
storage.not_a_directory: That path is a file, not a folder.
storage.create_failed: That folder could not be created. Check the drive is connected and not full.
storage.not_writable: That folder refused to be written to. It may be read-only, or on a share you cannot write to.
storage.inside_installation: That folder is inside the application itself, and would be erased by the next update.
storage.not_remembered: The folder is in use now, but could not be saved, so the next launch will use the previous one.
storage.picker_failed: The folder picker could not be opened.

window.command_failed: The window did not respond to that action.

vibrancy.apply_failed: The window blur effect could not be applied.
vibrancy.windows10_opt_in: Window blur is off by default on Windows 10, because it slows down dragging.
vibrancy.unsupported_platform: Window blur is not available on this system.

conform.bad_image: That image could not be read.
conform.already_at_size: The sprite was already at or below the size asked for, so its cells were left where they were and only the colours and the edge were corrected.
conform.background_uncertain: The background fill either found almost nothing or cleared almost everything, which is what a photographic background looks like to it. Check the edge of the sprite.
conform.grid_anisotropic: The cells came out taller than they are wide, which usually means the image was resized on one axis at some point.
conform.grid_not_found: No pixel grid was found in this image, so the cells were placed from the requested size rather than measured. The result is a resize rather than a correction.

shell.not_a_directory: That folder does not exist yet. It is created the first time something is written there.
shell.open_failed: The system refused to open that.
shell.url_not_allowed: That link is not one this application opens.
shell.no_storage_info: The storage locations have not been read yet. Open Settings once, then try again.
shell.unavailable: This window is not connected to the application shell, so nothing can be read or written.

document.not_found: That project, sprite or layer is no longer in the database.
document.invalid_name: A name has to be between one and 1024 bytes, and cannot contain control characters.
document.invalid_dimensions: That canvas size is not one a sprite can be created at.
document.invalid_step: That is not a step in the workflow.
document.invalid_role: That is not a layer role this document has.
document.invalid_buffer: The layer's bytes do not match its size, or name a palette slot that does not exist.
document.invalid_batch: That batch of edits was rejected before any of it was written.
document.layer_locked: That layer is locked, so nothing was written to it.
document.layer_not_found: That layer has not been drawn yet.
document.nothing_to_undo: There is nothing left to undo on this sprite.
document.nothing_to_redo: There is nothing to redo on this sprite.

palette.unknown_slot: That palette slot does not exist in this sprite.
palette.too_many_slots: The palette has more colours than this project's style allows.
palette.invalid_index: The slots have to be numbered from 1 upwards with no gaps.
palette.invalid_ramp: A ramp is wrong: a name is empty or repeated, a slot appears twice, or a slot's ramp and its position in it disagree.
palette.rule_violation: The palette breaks one of the style's rules. A ramp that only changes lightness is the usual cause: shadows have to move cool and lose chroma, and lights have to move warm.

asset.invalid_kind: That is not a kind of sprite this application makes.

style.invalid_preset: That is not a style preset this application ships.

step.complete: This sprite is at the last step of the workflow.
step.gate_failed: The current step's checks did not pass, so the sprite did not advance.

store.constraint: Something with that name already exists here.
store.database_failed: The database refused that. It may be open in another copy of the application.
store.lock_failed: The database was left locked by a failure, so this window has to be restarted.
store.worker_failed: The database worker stopped before it answered.
store.migration_missing: The database is older than this build and has no upgrade path to it.
store.newer_schema: The database was written by a newer build than this one.

reference.invalid: That reference could not be read.
reference.invalid_buffer: The conformed reference is not an image the size of the sprite.
reference.invalid_owner: That reference belongs to another sprite.
reference.invalid_ramp: The reference's colours could not be turned into ramps.
reference.none: This sprite has no reference image yet. Import one first.
reference.not_conformed: That reference was stored without a conformed image.
reference.picker_failed: The file picker could not be opened.
reference.too_large: That file is larger than 20 MB, which is too large for a reference.
reference.unreadable: That file could not be read as an image.

tilemap.exists: This background already has a tilemap.
tilemap.invalid_layer: A layer needs a name of 1 to 40 characters and a parallax from 0 to 4.
tilemap.invalid_size: Tiles must be 8 to 64 pixels, the map 1 to 256 tiles a side and at most 4096 pixels a side, with 1 to 8 layers.
tilemap.last_layer: A tilemap keeps at least one layer.
tilemap.layer_exists: A layer with that name already exists.
tilemap.none: This background has no tilemap yet.
tilemap.not_background: Only a background asset can hold a tilemap.
tilemap.out_of_bounds: That cell is outside the map.
tilemap.tile_invalid: That tile cannot be placed: it must be a tile asset of this project, the map's tile size.
tilemap.tile_missing: A placed tile no longer exists.
tilemap.tile_size: A placed tile is not the map's tile size.
tilemap.too_many_tiles: The map uses more distinct tiles than can be shown at once.

export.exists: A file with that name is already there.
export.invalid_pattern: The file name is empty once its placeholders are filled in.
export.invalid_scale: Choose a scale from 1 to 16 that keeps the image within 8192 pixels a side.
export.mixed_projects: A sheet can only hold sprites from one project.
export.mixed_sizes: A sheet needs every sprite to be the same size.
export.write_failed: The file could not be written. Check the folder is writable and the drive is not full.
